title: DCI PRESENTATION TO THE PFIAB, 7 DECEMBER 1962
title_ja: 1962年12月7日、PFIABに対するDCIのプレゼンテーション
summary: DCI Presentation to the PFIAB on December 7, 1962, covering topics such as OXCART, budget issues, and Operation MONGOOSE.
